name: invest
description: Self-hosted multi-asset AI investment committee. View portfolio + live prices, track any yfinance symbol (A-share / HK / US / ETF / crypto / commodity), and run a 4-role LLM committee for buy/sell verdicts. The backend self-bootstraps (git clone + uv sync) on first call — the plugin only ships the agent skill layer.

interface.longDescription: Four LLM roles (Macro Strategist, Quant, Risk Officer, CIO) debate any yfinance symbol and return a calibrated BUY/HOLD/SELL verdict with a written memo. Multi-currency portfolio ledger, decision accounting (which advice you followed, and the PnL of what the rules blocked), 14 MCP tools with destructive-action hints. Backend installs from PyPI via uvx — no clone, no daemon. Never places real orders; not investment advice.
